mastery_task.scenario_en: A fictional class partner messages you before the first session.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: زميل خيالي يراسلك قبل أول محاضرة.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Reply with two requested details, ask for one missing detail, confirm it, and close.
mastery_task.support: Message-purpose icons only; no complete frames or model exchange.
mastery_task.freshness: The request, missing field, values, and message order differ from practice.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: A fictional volunteer coordinator starts a different short message exchange.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: منسق متطوعين خيالي يبدأ تبادل رسائل مختلفًا.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Provide the changed requested details, retrieve one missing detail, confirm, and close.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Message-purpose icons only; no complete frames or model exchange.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: A new role, request, field, and values keep the interaction equivalent and fresh.

rubric.level_2: The incoming request and missing detail are identified correctly.
Reply, question, confirmation, and closing complete the exchange accurately.
The learner adapts to a changed request and field without copying the model.
A written detail is confirmed or repaired without changing its value.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; use targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening sections or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح إزاي رسالة صحيحة في القواعد ممكن تبقى رد غير مناسب، وادّي مثال قصير.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: Reply to a changed two-detail request.
Ask for and confirm a missing fictional detail.
Complete a fresh four-move written exchange.
